chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from al-'Iyyas ibn al-Qasim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Fitrah (alms of fasting), when is it? He said: Before the prayer on the day of Eid al-Fitr. I said: If some of it remains after the prayer? He said: There is no harm. We give our dependents from it, then it remains and we divide it.

key_terms.الْفِطْرَة: Fitrah (alms of fasting given at the end of Ramadan)

ai.seo_question: When should Fitrah be distributed before or after Eid prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani’s chain in al-istibsar clarifies the temporal preference for distributing Fitrah, emphasizing its role in purifying the fasting person before the communal Eid prayer. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that while pre-prayer distribution is optimal to fulfill the sunnah, post-prayer distribution remains valid, allowing for practical flexibility in household management as illustrated by the division of surplus among dependents.
